item.title: Snowboarding's oldest competitor chases his first solo gold medal
item.description: Four years after Nick Baumgartner won a snowboarding gold medal at age 40, he says he's a better athlete than ever, even in an Olympic sport dominated by youth.

item.title: Trump taps Kevin Warsh to chair Federal Reserve
item.description: President Donald Trump plans to nominate Kevin Warsh to the board of the Federal Reserve as a governor and the next chair of the central bank

item.title: Mississippi shivers as thousands stuck without power after ice storm brace for a deep freeze
item.description: A week after a historic winter storm paralyzed communities across the Southeast, Mississippi officials are still racing to keep residents safe, warm and fed.

item.title: Actress, writer, and comedian Catherine O’Hara has died at 71
item.description: Known for iconic roles in Beetlejuice, Home Alone, Schitt’s Creek and so much more, Catherine O’Hara died at home after a brief illness. NBC News’ Anne Thompson reports on her incredible life and career.

item.title: ‘Mommy, open the door’: Mother recounts her terror as her 5-year-old was taken by ICE
item.description: Liam Conejo Ramos was taken with his father, Adrián Alexander Conejo Arias, when the two returned home Jan. 20 from Liam’s preschool, according to a school official.

item.title: ICE detainee's death ruled a homicide by medical examiner
item.description: The autopsy report for Geraldo Lunas Campos says he died by asphyxia due to neck and torso compression.

item.title: Don Lemon arrested by federal authorities in connection with Minnesota church protest
item.description: Former CNN anchor Don Lemon was released by a federal judge on Friday after he was charged by the Trump administration with violating the freedom of religion of worshippers at a Minnesota church where he was covering a protest earlier this month

item.title: DOJ opens a civil rights probe into Alex Pretti's fatal shooting in Minneapolis, deputy AG says
item.description: The Department of Justice has opened a federal civil rights probe into the fatal shooting of Alex Pretti in Minneapolis, Deputy Attorney General Todd Blanche said in a Friday.

item.title: 3 million pages of Epstein documents released
item.description: The Department of Justice released 3 million pages of Epstein documents, along with 2,000 videos and 180,000 photos. The release included emails between Elon Musk and Epstein, coordinating a possible visit to the billionaire’s infamous island. It’s unclear if he actually visited and Musk has previously said he denied Epstein’s invitations to visit. NBC News’ Ryan Nobles reports.

item.title: Senate approves spending package allowing for DHS funding negotiation
item.description: The Senate has voted to approve a spending package that could avert a government shutdown. As part of the deal, senators stripped out new Homeland Security funding so Democrats and the White House could continue negotiation on potential changes to ICE and Border Patrol.
